scenes.title: Meet Nova
scenes.caption: NovaLab: AI-guided virtual science labs for every school.
scenes.narration: This is NovaLab, an AI-powered virtual science lab built for secondary schools. In this demo, our AI agent completes a real biology practical entirely on its own.

scenes.title: The mission
scenes.caption: Goal: complete DNA extraction, record evidence, and explain the result.
scenes.narration: It has one goal: carry out the DNA extraction experiment, record the evidence, and explain what the result means.

scenes.title: Selecting apparatus
scenes.caption: Selecting apparatus: specimen tray, measuring cylinder, forceps and rod, microscope.
scenes.narration: The agent scans the bench and selects the correct apparatus: a specimen tray, a measuring cylinder, forceps and a glass rod, and a microscope for close observation.

scenes.title: Running the trial
scenes.caption: Virtual trial: cells break open and DNA is released.
scenes.narration: It runs a virtual trial. The mixture turns cloudy as the cells break open and DNA is released into the solution.

scenes.title: Recording evidence
scenes.caption: Evidence: 62 millilitres measured. White strands form at the ethanol layer.
scenes.narration: Next, it records the evidence like a real student, noting the volume measured and the white strands forming at the ethanol layer.

scenes.title: Completing the practical
scenes.caption: Guided steps: prepare, separate, precipitate, and collect the DNA.
scenes.narration: The agent works through each guided step. It prepares the sample, separates the cell debris, adds ice-cold ethanol to precipitate the DNA, and finally spools the white strands onto a glass rod. Every action is checked and scored automatically.

scenes.title: Practical complete
scenes.caption: Practical complete: 100 percent score and a full evidence record.
scenes.narration: The practical is complete. The agent has a full record of its measurements and observations, and a final score of one hundred percent. That same record is saved for the teacher.

scenes.title: Real science, safely, anywhere
scenes.caption: Real science, safely, anywhere.
scenes.narration: NovaLab makes practical science safe, affordable, and available to every learner. Real science, safely, anywhere.
